modelCard.what: A simulated score range and win chance for every regular-season NFL game, generated from a team-strength rating (Elo) that has watched three seasons of finals, and frozen before kickoff.
modelCard.honestLimit: Tested on a full held-out 2025 season this model picked about 64% of winners (log loss 0.6478 against a coin's 0.6931). It has NOT been shown to beat the sportsbook market, and its 2026 walk-forward evaluation starts at Week 1 under bars that were frozen in August — until that sample accumulates, every forecast is experimental.
modelCard.whatItIsGoodFor: An honest, reproducible pre-kickoff baseline: which side is likelier, by how much, and how wide the range really is (80% score intervals covered 80.15% on held-out 2025 regular-season games).
modelCard.whyPublishItAtAll: The frozen evaluation contract requires pre-kickoff forecasts-of-record to exist before any of them can be judged. Publishing them, clearly labeled, is how the record accumulates without a single number being backfilled.

teamSignal.note: Team strength moves this forecast: the Elo-logistic win head over a 854-game rating history is the head the committed evaluation measured on a held-out 2025 season (log loss 0.6478 against a coin's 0.6931, about 64% of winners). It has not been shown to beat the sportsbook market.

winProbability.calibration: From the replay-validated Elo-logistic head, published exactly as evaluated on a held-out 2025 season — no shrink toward 50% is applied, and no claim to beat the market is made.
